_comment: What a raw parameter number MEANS, for devices where Reason's Remote layer reports a bare number instead of its on-screen label. The MClass Compressor reports '30 ms' and needs nothing here; Scream 4 reports '4' where the panel says 'Tape'. Names and their ORDER are from the Reason 12.7 Operation Manual ch.51, 'Scream 4 Sound Destruction Unit' (Damage types pp. listed in order Overdrive..Scream; 'Body Type knob ... one of the five available Body types (A-E)'). Applied to the measured calibration table at load time by dial_llm.load_calibration().

RV7000 Advanced Reverb._comment: PROVISIONAL -- an inference from the Operation Manual ch.53, NOT yet seen on a sweep. The ten algorithms are listed in the manual's own order and the Edit Mode button steps Reverb -> EQ -> Gate. If the device turns out to report real words, these are ignored (only bare numbers are ever rewritten). Check the names calibrate.py prints against the panel before trusting them.

Dr.REX Loop Player._comment: PROVISIONAL -- names and their ORDER are from the Reason 12.7 Operation Manual ch.29 'Dr. Octo Rex Loop Player', NOT read off the panel. Every list's LENGTH was checked against the sweep: five filter modes in the manual and five distinct readings off Reason, six waveforms and six readings, three destinations and three, three Trig Next settings and three. That agreement is why the order is trusted; Step 8 of TESTING-VOICE-DIAL.md confirms it against the panel. Rex reports every picker as a bare number, so without this 'stop the loop' resolves to nothing and moves nothing. Only bare numbers are ever rewritten -- if a future sweep finds real words, this is ignored.

units._comment: What a bare number on a knob MEANS, where Reason reports the figure but not its unit. Only knobs whose ZERO POINT is unambiguous belong here: Transpose reads -12..12 and 0 is plainly no transposition. Dr. Octo Rex's Osc Octave reads 0..8 with the neutral position somewhere in the middle, so labelling it 'octaves' would make '4 octaves' mean no change -- it is deliberately absent until the panel settles where its zero is. A knob that already measured a real unit is never overwritten.
